selector_meta.method: MaskedKD top-K (last student block CLS attention) with kd_weight 0.5 on every image
selector_meta.paper: Son et al. 2023 (MaskedKD); diagnostic control for H-C25 rand_dyn
selector_meta.why: separates KD-weight dilution from per-image coverage as the reason all-or-nothing rand_dyn@98 stays at CE level while maskedkd@98 reaches Full
selector_meta.vs_maskedkd: same tokens and teacher cost; only the KD term is weighted 0.5
selector_meta.prior_art: none claimed; this is a loss-weight ablation, not a selector
